sharedProposal.Authority: All22 entries remain UNADOPTED and UNSENT. Every original source object, full question, Warrior counterpart and applicable narrow review binding is retained. No heritage, world origin, cosmology, source deletion or public feat activation is decided here. Reviewed condition, healing, timing, maximumHP, equipment and source-specific interfaces continue in their actual scopes; whole-feat/class approval is not inferred from a reviewed component.
sharedProposal.One paid identity: NEW reconcile each of the12 named Warrior mutation-feat pairs as one feat grant with two preserved source representations. The proposed operating rule is the specific procedure below, using the counterpart actual Warrior-level/equipped gates and explicitly identifying changes from standalone wording. Choosing through a general feat opportunity or the Warrior supplement spends one real feat choice, never both and never a free mutation selection. No duplicate benefits, charges or ledgers. These feats consume no mutation slot, but their prerequisites do. Minimum Warrior levels are class levels; ability prerequisites use permanent ability scores. The source category Aberrant_mutation alone does not add a Warrior gate to Aberrant Mind, which has no counterpart.
sharedProposal.Equipped and active: Equipped mutations occupy real unlocked slots and satisfy acquisition requirements. Active means a legally activated and currently unsuppressed mutation; dormant/equipped-only never supplies an active benefit. Current Warrior slot, simultaneous-active, Basic/Advanced/Apex, serum-dose, Strain, duration and unique-name limits remain. Mutation Efficiency and actual temporary exceptions must already be acquired. Each procedure states required active mutations. Suppression removes the relevant benefit without refilling resources; original clocks continue. Removing a required equipped prerequisite suppresses the feat until legitimately restored, without deleting its acquisition record. No feat creates serum doses, mutation access, BT or a class engine except its explicit bounded grant.
sharedProposal.Cadence and causal rules: Use current original regular-turn markers; extra turns neither create new per-round allowances nor advance periodic clocks. A numbered encounter round has one shared identity across actors. Once-per-combat means once in a real encounter with meaningful risk; exit/reentry, waves and staged sparring do not refresh. Per-day means24 elapsed hours from committed activation, distinct from beneficial rests. Per-rest here means completed beneficial SR or LR; LR-only remains LR-only. Retain the shared one additional fullAction and source-character/target/encounter hard-denial guards. A legal committed attempt pays even on failure; reject illegal attempts before payment.
sharedProposal.Heritage eligibility: NEW each named heritage prerequisite requires the actual chosen base ancestry record in the current reviewed ancestry candidate, or a later explicit reviewed heritage receipt. Its own variants qualify through that base; a costume, temporary form, similar name or an unadopted alternative builder variant does not. No mixed-heritage grant is invented. Source identity and heritage eligibility are rules receipts, not claims about origin, personality or culture. Feats are separate paid choices; ancestry traits do not supply them free.
sharedProposal.Arithmetic and scope: Preserve current native attack/spell, damage-event and source-owner distinctions. Resistance to the same type never stacks. Numeric actual damage means actualHP damage plus temporaryHP actually absorbed, excluding overkill and mere state assignment; a hit can occur without positive damage. Distinct compatible percentage bonuses use the existing unadopted combat proposal: apply each floored increment to the same native pre-percentage amount after critical/flat additions and before defenses, never multiply each other. Actual packet boundaries remain. Same feat-family repeated records do not add magnitudes unless the feat explicitly supplies its finite stack counter. No copy/reflection/companion packet becomes a new personal attack or kill.
sharedProposal.Preserved disagreements: The proposed choices are not recovered canon: broader standalone action denial becomes the counterpart Reaction loss; Synaptic Rot follows actual Silenced, not universal spell shutdown; Living Fortress denies only real flanking-derived advantage; Bloodthick enhancement stays a finite modifier; temporary ancestry effects receive explicit clocks and scope. Every original promise remains visible beside these proposed resolutions for GPT to accept, revise or reject.

Recipient may refuse/end communication; you cannot read thoughts, memories, emotions or intentions, compel responses, or impersonate a voice. Maintain actual range/line of effect; loss ends the link. Silence/Deafened alone does not block purely mental speech, but Unconscious or explicit telepathy/mental-communication protection does. One channel at a time, no relay or shared senses. This grants no Aberration creature type, mutation activation or alien-origin fact.

proposals.procedure: Require actual Troll heritage. NEW once per real encounter, when one eligible adverse condition record would apply to you, or at the start of your own original regular turn, voluntarily end that one selected record immediately without Action/BA/Reaction. On-application choice occurs before its consequences and may avert its resulting incapacity. At your start you must still be alive and conscious; this specific non-action choice may be made while Incapacitated, Stunned or Paralyzed, but supplies no other actions. Select one ordinary source-applied Blinded, Deafened, Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned, Staggered, Stunned, Paralyzed, Silenced, Slowed, Root, Shaken, Disoriented, Weakened, Dazed, Bleeding, ongoing-fire or magical-sleep record with an ordinary removal endpoint. Pending Disoriented can be ended before transition. Explicit protected/artifact/special-cure-only records remain protected. This is a NEW finite interpretation of any debuff/status, not silent proof of the broad source promise. No cure of death, zeroHP Unconscious/dying state, Wounds/Injuries, disease/curses, exhaustion, serum/expedition Strain, class-resource costs, physical restraints/Grappled/Restrained, actual blindness from absent eyes, or environmental cause. Root qualifies only if magical/control, not physical ties. It ends one effect record, not its parent area/poison/disease, and may be reapplied by a later legal exposure. Removing Poisoned does not cancel a separate damage schedule. A current engulfingfire may create a new burn; the cure creates no lasting immunity. NoHP or regeneration pulse; acid/fire inhibition of Troll regeneration remains.

workedCases: A conscious Troll may use the feat at its start to end oneStunned record, then acts only if no other restriction remains.
It may remove ordinaryBleeding without healingHP, but cannot remove aWound or loosen the actual ropes causingRestrained.

proposals.procedure: NEW select the Warrior8 counterpart over nearby-any-save/all-spell-shutdown wording. Require Wailing Eye Cluster or Viral Core Sacs equipped and at least one of those exact mutations active. When an actual hostile within15ft and line of effect fails anINT orWIS save against your own direct Warrior feature, apply actualSilenced until the end of its next future regular turn, once per target per numbered round. The generating Warrior feature need not be the equipped prerequisite itself, but must be actually acquired/active/legal; an ally spell or unrelated ordinary spell does not qualify. Source names Wailing Eye and Viral Core bind only to the named actual cards. ActualSilenced prevents verbal components, command words, Chants and audible coordination; nonverbal spells and nonspell abilities remain possible if otherwise legal. No new universal spell ban or action loss. Same-profile reapplication may preserve later expiry without stacking, but the round ledger and source immunity apply. Gaining a nonverbal casting permission is not retroactively denied. No automatic target identification, sound-detection channel or ongoing15ft tether after application; later range loss does not erase the legal record.

NEW the first positive resolved event in the numbered round while this predicate holds receives2whole-event damage reduction, minimum0, after passive typed defenses and before temporaryHP. proposals.procedure: Require actual Human heritage. NEW once per completed beneficialSR orLR, borrow one permitted class skill for one check OR one class ability activation from a real willing current party member. Before use, spend one uninterrupted minute together within5ft communicating through an actual shared language/channel; choose the exact currently acquired donor skill/card and record donor consent. This preparation changes no resources and does not spend the use; one prepared choice at a time, ending at the next completedrest or replacement. Donor must have it through actual class training/acquisition, not a copied, borrowed or suppressed grant; you must meet actual body/equipment and the menu's total-level gate. You may then consume the feat use on your own legal check/activation while donor is conscious within30ft and can perceive/understand your signal; donor spends noAction, use or resource. A skill choice uses your own ability+normalPB for one real check, replacing lower proficiency, never donor ability, expertise or passive bonus; the task must actually use that donor's class-granted skill. An ability choice uses one of the twelve exact permitted cards/procedures below, your own stats/PB/materials and actual activation cost. These finite NEW borrowing limits deliberately narrow the source's otherwise unbounded class-ability promise for joint decision. No extra feat use after failure, no copied class levels/engines, passive/Arch/Hero/finale ability, transformation, companion, summon, item production, resource generation, permanent learning or further borrowing. The menu grants a one-use ability permission, never its independent class resource pool; actual1RP cost must be paid from your existing personal legalRPpool. Shared spell/Weave restrictions still apply where printed. An already-known same card shares its own recharge/use ledger, so borrowing cannot bypass a spent natural entitlement; an unknown menu card gets only this one borrowed activation and its future recharge history is retained. Existing ordinary resources and restrictions persist after the temporary permission ends. Lasting riders keep their original deadlines and source identity, with you as actor and donor provenance retained.
proposals.newChoices: Consent/minute preparation, one check or exact twelve-card activation, own actual costs, bounded statistics and no permanent/copy/resource engine.
workedCases: A willing Soldier teaches Tactical Reposition; the Human spends its ownBA and feat use to move half its ownSpeed along a legal route.
Borrowing Nature's Whisper still costs1realRP. A Human with noRPpool cannot pay and must choose a different legal option before committing.
